learnings: Read a traceback bottom-up: the last line names the exception, the frame above it shows where.
Debug output goes to stderr behind a switch, never mixed into real output.
`breakpoint()` respects `PYTHONBREAKPOINT=0`, so breakpoints can stay in code safely.
pitfalls: Isolating the *first* failing input (an empty week) found the bug faster than reading code.
